name: Information is the Key (Celt)
offer: Research information about the Moonstone. Speak with Merle the Old.

steps.text: Speak with Merle about the Moonstone.
Kill mudmen and bring Merle ten bits of mud (four, then three, two and one more).
Give Merle the mud so he will tell you what he knows.

notes: Race-specific version (Celt start). Allakhazam's key H324 had a 2006 first comment but a low id (period).

name: Information is the Key (Elf)
offer: Research information about the Moonstone. Talk to Maeve the Crone, in her hut past Ardee.

steps.text: Talk to Maeve the Crone in her hut a little past Ardee.
Kill rat boys and bring Maeve ten tails (four, then three, two and one more).
Give Maeve the tails; choose one topic to learn about.

name: Magic in the Grove
offer: Miari needs help again: the Fomorian evil makes her seeds grow wrong.

steps.text: Speak with Miari.
Kill three bantam shrouders behind the first guard tower for their tentacles.
Give Miari the tentacles.

steps.where: Miari's grove by the willow tree southwest of the city
steps.text: Take the amulet to Miari's grove, southwest of the city by a willow tree, and use it there.
Return to Miari.

name: Magical Disturbances
offer: Strange things are going on in the grove. Talk with Liisu.

steps.text: Talk with Liisu about the strange things in the grove.
Speak to Aapo.
Wear the necklace and kill the two tangleweeds eating the grove roots just outside the gates.
Return the weeds to Aapo.
Spread the magical seeds in the grove.
Return to Aapo.

notes: Ending after the seeds is cut off; finish NPC assumed.

name: Mild Deception
offer: The guards are hunting a certain stalker. Will you assist in a mildly nefarious deed? Trick the lurikeen tracker into giving you a note meant for someone else.

steps.text: Speak with the tracker in red armour due west across the road and claim you are [here to aid].
Give the note to Achaius, the wandering weapons merchant between Mag Mell and Ardee.

notes: Southern version delivers to Twm outside Howth. Allakhazam spells Achius/Achaius.

name: Enchanted Bandit Hunt
offer: A sabhail named Seireadan stole an enchanted dagger from Anra's father and uses it to look like a lurikeen while waylaying travellers.

steps.text: Find the 'lurikeen' Seireadan in the valley west of Howth, past the ridge, a bit north. Speak to him, then do away with him.
Return the dagger to Anra, the lurikeen weapons merchant on the west side of Howth.

name: Learn the Paths
offer: You near the time you must choose your path.

steps.text: Speak with Serenda, the Hero trainer, in the first tree on the right in the Grove.
Speak with Sean McCrean, the Champion trainer.
Speak with Aurnia, the Blademaster trainer, in the tree behind Searlait.
Return to Searlait.

name: Summoner Expulsion
offer: A summoner has corrupted the stone obelisk northwest of Mag Mell and keeps pulling the dead from their graves. Stop him.

steps.text: Kill the summoner at the stone obelisk northwest of Mag Mell.
Return to your trainer.

notes: Summoner monster name (level 4) to resolve; named spawn may be needed.

name: Tale of Cad Goddeau
offer: Do you know about Cad Goddeau? Ask the Druid trainer at the tower over the bridge.

steps.text: Say [Cad Goddeau] to the Druid trainer at the tower over the bridge from Connla.
Return to your trainer.

name: Track and Seek
offer: Locate a certain tracker, follow her, and find out from whom she receives information.

steps.where: near Merle the Old on the ridge west of Howth
steps.text: Find the elven tracker in blue armour who wanders the hills west of Howth and follow her to her informant.
Return to Damhnait: the Unnamed One is close to finding the Moonstone.

steps.whisper: the Unnamed One seeks the Moonstone
steps.text: Pass the information to Leachlainn, the Nightshade trainer in Ardagh.

notes: Exact phrase not recorded.

name: Way of the Grove -- Learning the Paths
offer: Learn of the paths open to a forester.

steps.text: Talk to Faolan about the Path of Affinity and life as an Animist.
Speak to Oriana about life as a Valewalker.

name: Wolf Infestation
offer: The wolves wandering near town are starving. Take this food and feed them.

steps.text: Feed three of the lough wolves near Caoimhe's house.
Return to Caoimhe in Mag Mell.

notes: Magic ring name not recorded (item pass 2). The trainer names Eluned; the NPC that answers is Caoimhe. 'use_item on target' step: generator treats the use near a lough wolf as progress.

name: Youth Gone Wrong
offer: I've broken away from the gang of villainous youths and I'm hiding here from their hit gangs.

steps.text: Two villainous youths come for Mandra behind the main building in Mag Mell. Defeat them.
Talk to Mandra.

name: Kylirean's New Armor
offer: I need materials for new armour.

steps.text: Kill a lough wolf cadger for its skin.
Return the skin to Kylirean, the armour merchant in Mag Mell.
Kill a mudman for a rock chert.
Return the chert to Kylirean.

notes: Choker of the Bear reward added in 1.69 (not used).

name: Spicket, Spackit and Spykit
offer: Three spraggons plague us. Kill one of them and keep its little magical charm - bring proof of its death to Tethra in Ardee. Would you rather be [stronger], more [dexterous] or [smarter]?

steps.text: Kill the spraggon you chose: Spicket (woods west of the bridge north of Ardee), Spackit (valley northeast of Mag Mell) or Spykit (just over the hill northeast of Mag Mell). They appear at night.
Bring proof of its death to Tethra in the middle house in Ardee.

steps.where: under the bridge north of Ardee
steps.text: Search under the bridge north of Ardee.
Hand Tethra the bag.

notes: The charm drops from the chosen spraggon itself.

name: The Bug Catcher's Studies
offer: I study the bugs of this land. Bring me specimens.

steps.text: Kill an eirebug for a set of eyes.
Kill a water beetle collector for its carapace.
Return to Ignius outside the east entrance of Tir na Nog.

name: Evan's Notes
offer: Deliver this love letter to my girlfriend Meara in Mag Mell.

steps.text: Hand the letter to Meara, a firbolg guard in Mag Mell.
Return the letter to Evan in Ardee.

name: Cristin's Supplies
offer: Will you help me gather the items my cousin needs to repair damaged armour?

steps.text: Kill a water beetle on the riverbank along the road south of Basar.
Kill a hill toad on the hill west of Ardee near Muire's Tomb.
Kill a spraggonite on the same hill.
Visit Cristin in Basar and hand over the items.

name: Straw's In Town
offer: A spraggon named Straw is so fast the guards have never caught him. Talk to Rolney at the tower in Ardagh.

steps.text: Find Rolney at the top of the tower in Ardagh.
Odharnait in Ardagh can help you find Straw.
Straw appears at night with a band of spraggons by the dead tree and the boulder on the hill northwest of Ardagh.
Take Straw's head to Sentinel Eimile in Ardagh.

notes: The daytime Straw on the peninsula east of Tir na mBeo could not be hit (it only pointed to Odharnait).

name: Clik's Raids
offer: A thieving water beetle named Clik snitched my jewels. Help me get them back.

steps.text: Kill water beetles up the coast to recover the stolen necklace.
And the earring.
And the ring.
Kill Clik in the small bay just southeast of Mag Mell (he calls for help).
Return all four items to Caitriona in Ardagh.

name: Gormghlaith's Tea
offer: Lucricaduanes in the Silvermine Mountains stole my valuable teapot.

steps.text: Kill lucricaduanes in the valley at the north edge of the Silvermine Mountains for the teapot.
Return the teapot to Gormghlaith outside Howth by the stable master.
Get a blackwood leaf from a lunantishee by the road south from Mag Mell.
Get wolf whiskers from a lough wolf.
Return to Gormghlaith with the tea ingredients.

notes: Her son in Ardee gives the rumour. Leprechaun/blackwood faction loss on kills.

name: Little Wind
offer: Make a bottle to capture the wind ghoul Little Wind so we may learn of the lost treasures of the Tower.

steps.text: Get a water beetle eye along the lake shore for the cork.
Get a spraggonoll leg bone for the bottle.
Return the eye and the bone to Reidie in the Tir na mBeo tavern.
Northwest of Ardee in the ruins where wind ghouls roam, kill wind ghouls until Little Wind appears (daytime) and defeat him.
Return the bottle to Reidie.

name: Cyllane's Cure
offer: Read my note; it tells you what I need.

steps.text: Read Cyllane's note.
Kill a sporite for a spore pod.
Kill a botonid leaf for its sap.
Kill a precocious cniogcrag for its eye.
Take the items to Niara, Priestess of the Grove, in the Grove of Domnann.
Take the potion back to Cyllane in Bann-didein.

steps.where: prepared circle west-southwest of the tree's southwest exit
steps.text: Go west-southwest to the prepared circle and activate the amulet.
Activate the cure.
Return to Cyllane.

notes: Rewards class-specific (torso armour for Valewalker/Enchanter/Eldritch, a Mentalism staff for Mentalists) - names from item pass 2.

name: Fagan's Wand
offer: Retrieve the two broken halves of the Blackthorn Wand.

steps.drops: Bottom Half of the Blackthorn Wand
steps.text: Kill the enchanted creature that carries the bottom half of the wand.

steps.item: Bottom Half of the Blackthorn Wand
steps.text: Give Nyderra in Ardee the bottom half of the wand.

steps.drops: Top Half of the Blackthorn Wand
steps.text: Find the lunantishee Prunar in the wood northwest of Tir na mBeo.

steps.item: Top Half of the Blackthorn Wand
steps.text: Return the top half to Nyderra.

name: Lochlain's Curse
offer: I was cursed to look like a lurikeen. I need three items to remove the curse.

steps.text: Get a barca's spirit in Bri Leith.
Get a broken mirror from a siabra enchanter on the siabra island east of Tir na mBeo.
Get a siabra knife from the siabra house south of the Bri Leith entrance.
Take the items back to Lochlain in Ardagh.

notes: Celt/Firbolg version of Keara's Enchantment. The curse is not lifted (small reward).

name: Rhian's Dyes
offer: I am running low on dyes and need components.

steps.text: Get a badger scent gland along the road south from Mag Mell.
Get hair from a wild lucradan.
Get the third component from a large eirebug.
Return to Rhian in Tir na mBeo.

notes: Formerly Tyree's Dyes. Third item name reconstructed.

name: Keara's Enchantment
offer: A Celt turned me into a male Celt. Help me lift the enchantment.

steps.text: Get a veil from a veil wisp northeast of the guard tower on the way to Caille.
Get a broken mirror from a siabra enchanter.
Get the skin of the changeling among the anger sprites northwest of Ardee.
Return to Keara on the second floor in Ardee.

name: Whatcha Gonna Do
offer: I am being stalked!

steps.text: Tell Crace that Ailionora is being [stalked].
Go back to Ailionora.
Kill a stalking sylvanshade west of the city across the water, then north.
Return the hand to Ailionora.
Kill another one.
Return to Crace.
Tell Ailionora that it was [after Tiaga].

notes: Eldritch/Mentalist/Animist rewards not listed. Champion got scale in the period (reinforced after 1.69).

name: The Hunt for Bristle
offer: Talk to Reidie in Tir na mBeo about Bristle.

steps.text: Talk to Reidie in Tir na mBeo about Bristle.
Find the badger Bristle on the hill west (southwest) of Tir na mBeo and take his head.
Give Bristle's head to Reidie.
Return to Eruven in Basar and give him the sealed bag.

name: The Status of Information
offer: Speak with Anola outside town near the portal.

steps.text: Speak with Anola outside town near the portal back to Druim Ligen.
Read the notes Anola gave you.
Find the matted vines and the information hidden there (or ask Ceana or Oidhche).
Return the information to Ceana.
Kill two nibby cniogcrags for their collars.
Return the collars to Ceana.
Take the pouch to Niara near the centre of town.
Give the note to Anraoi.

notes: Role-play branches via Oidhche or Ceana. Eldritch/Animist mapping inferred.

name: Beautiful Music
offer: My wonderful drum is missing! My twin sister Tira in Ardee stole it.

steps.text: Go talk to Tira in Ardee.
Recover Tira's missing flute (from the anger spites).
Return the flute to Tira.
Get sinew from a curmudgeon trapper west of Ardagh.
Return the sinew to Tira.
Get a piece of driftwood from a roane maiden.
Get a seashell from Lelly, a named roane maiden on the shore northwest of the parthanan farm.
Return the driftwood to Tira.
Return to Tavie in Tir na mBeo with her drum, the lute and the seashell.

notes: Flute source not stated (related NPC anger spite).

name: Lesser Of Two Evils
offer: See Fereinn on the island in Lough Derg.

steps.text: See Fereinn on the island in Lough Derg.
Kill the curmudgeon trapper Tharl as proof of your sincerity.
Give Fereinn the ear.
Kill a courier and bring back the plans.
Assist the siabra force to defeat the curmudgeons at their battle at high noon.
Report back to Fereinn.
Give the book to Aidaila in Tir na mBeo.

notes: The path depends on siabra/curmudgeon faction (this is the siabra path). Myfanwy points to Aidaila.

name: Two Ales, Ailish!
offer: Notice anything missing? My glasses! I've been to three places recently.

steps.text: Ask Vivienne, the scale armour merchant in Ceannai.
Ask Sentinel Casidhe in Tir Uphost.
Ask Brynn, the enchanter staff merchant in Caille, who found them in the grass.
Return the glasses to Iao in the Green Rose Pub.

name: Fearan
offer: I am planting an otherworld garden and need the spores of a dew sheerie taken to Cait in Howth.

steps.text: Get the spores of a dew sheerie on the eastern shore of the loch, east of Ardagh.
Take the spores to Cait in Howth.
Get otherworld soil from a deamhan creig (or ask Merlo near Howth for [soil from the otherworld]).
Return to Cait.
Ainrebh the enchanter in Caille must seal the magic between the soil and the spores.
Get grass seeds from a grass sheerie west-northwest of Caille.
Return the seeds to Ainrebh.
Find and slay Fearan, who runs the hill crest with a companion.

notes: The finale against Fearan is reconstructed from the reward/loc notes.

name: Lysagh's Problem
offer: Check on my brother Lysagh in Caille and take him this armour shipment; fury sprites keep attacking him.

steps.text: Deliver the armour shipment to Lysagh in Caille.
Kill a grass sheerie past the lone guard tower for a green crystal.
Give the crystal to Lysagh; fury sprites come to mug him.
Kill Glare and the other fury sprite.
Give Lysagh the corpse of Glare and offer to take a letter to Gemma.
Take the letter to Gemma in Tir na Nog.

name: Regional Distinctions
offer: Speak to Lavena about the dergans in the area.

steps.text: Speak to Lavena in the first hut on the left of Tir na mBeo about the [dergans].
Kill a dergan fury for an uncut stone (the island behind Ardagh or the woods by the parthanan farm).
Return the stone to Lavena and learn why the dergans [occupy] Lough Derg.
Talk to Bevin by the dye merchants in Howth about the [unseelie court].
Kill the sheevra chieftain in the valley behind the mushroom ring across the stepping-stone bridge south of Howth.
Bevin sends you to Kyli on the dock in Connla.
Kill an eriu kedger in the valley on the road to Innis Carthaig.
Kyli sends you to Mosby in Tir Uphost.
Kill a moheran distorter behind the gales off the road from Tir na Nog to Tir Uphost (night).
Mosby sends you back to Raine in Tir na mBeo.

notes: Dergan/curmudgeon faction shifts. Reward not recorded; Eriu Kedger y-coordinate guessed (49.5k,? cut off).

name: Alastriona's Chest
offer: I broke my leg, and my chest of exotic furs was broken into. I tagged them magically; help me get them back.

steps.text: Get the white boar skin from a bantam spectre in the Cliffs of Moher (night).
Return it to Alastriona outside the east gate of Tir na Nog.
Get the cave bear pelt from a sheevra skirmisher in the woods before the parthanan farm.
Return the pelt.
Get a blood otter skin from an eiru fiscere north along the river from Connla.
Return the skin.
Get the cruiach daemon skin from Hughar, the named curmudgeon poacher southeast of the parthanan farm.
Take the last skin back to Alastriona.

notes: Some players also had to bring a sheevra archer item (step 4 varied).

name: Rest in Peace
offer: My family is cursed. Get rid of the curse before I go mad. Take my journal.

steps.text: Kill Beare Muire in Muire Tomb.
Kill Alsandair and keep his dueling sword.
Kill Conaire using the dueling sword.
Kill Shyene (her guards spawn when she is attacked).
Take Kacey's charm from her.
Destroy the charm at the foot of her resting place.
Kill Kacey again now that the charm is gone.
Kill Quillan.
Return to Gogarty Muire and give him the journal.

notes: Kacey's charm was meant to be stolen stealthily in the period game; the generator lets the first kill drop it.

name: Riona's Revenge
offer: The siabra captured me. I want revenge!

steps.text: Kill Dergal at the siabra camp across the lake from Howth and retrieve the vest with magical runes.
Kill an eiru fiscere along the shore south of the stepping-stone bridge (or an empyrean wisp near Caille).
Get a fire agate from a spectre that wanders west of the main city past the guard tower at night.
Kill a ghastly siabra for its essence.
Return to Riona at the Mardagh tower.

notes: Intermediate item names reconstructed; targets varied.

name: Sad Fomorie
offer: A fomorie named Glom sits moping in the hills south of the village. Check on him.

steps.text: Check on Glom on the hill south of Ardagh.
Track down the badger Stinky, who stole Glom's toy.
Return the toy to Glom.
Return to Reeni.

notes: Ending reconstructed.

name: Scuttle
offer: A fishing bear cub named Scuttle stole my lucky rock.

steps.text: Kill Scuttle on the small island east of the guard tower between Ardagh and Howth (around midnight).
Bring back the stone and Scuttle's tooth.
Get a glowing worm from the belly of a roane companion near the siabra island.
Return to Seana in Ardagh.

name: Spinner's Cloak
offer: Bring me four spraggoncle cloaks and I will spin you a cloak.

steps.text: Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks.
Return the cloaks to Banba in Howth.
Take the note to Reidie and choose a dye colour.
Give the dye to Banba.

notes: Cloak colour follows the chosen dye. Walkthrough says Reedi in 'Aargagh' (Ardagh?) - resolve.

name: Eoghan's Spell
offer: I am working on a spell and need help collecting components.

steps.text: Get a shaft of wheat from Satefe, the named parthanan in the parthanan farm.
Get a red candle from an empyrean watcher in the hills southeast of Caille.
Get a bowl of morning dew from a dew sheerie near the tower on the road to Caille.
Get a sprig of vervain from a gale in the Cliffs of Moher.
Return to Eoghan in Ardee.

name: Seeking Glory
offer: Learn of Glory, the bow. A sentinel in Bri Leith knows of it.

steps.text: Go into Bri Leith and talk to a sentinel about Glory.
Get an arrow from a siabran archer.
Seek Muadhnait, the elven weapon merchant at the shops between Mag Mell and Tir na mBeo.
Find Tangua, a rare spawn in the huts on the hill behind the parthanan farm.
Take the bow back to Tir na Nog.

notes: Paths vary by class; only Rangers get the bow, other classes silver.

name: Setting Sail
offer: Speak with Keagan in Connla.

steps.text: Speak with Keagan in Connla and follow the conversation.
Kill Ualtar in the woods with the dergans north of the parthanan farm.
Swim around the stepping stones near Howth until you find rock lichen.
Give Keagan the wood bowl and the rock lichen.
Speak with Evie.
Give the sailor the potion and talk to him until he recovers.
Speak with Evie.

notes: Taiga in the Grove of Domnann upgrades the charm to Tiaga's Blessed Charm.

name: The Feud
offer: Help settle a feud.

steps.text: Kill a faerie beetle in Connacht for a crystal eye.
Give the eye to Kean in Tir na mBeo and say it came from Tadhg.
Kill a large luch just east of Innis Carthaig for its ear.
Give the ear to Tadhg in Connla.
Kill the named deamhan creig Crag southwest of the spraggonoll camp (kill deamhan creigs until he appears).
Return to Lasrina in Howth with the two items.

notes: Period reward was the Aged Stone Staff, exchangeable later for the class version; spec gives the class staff directly. Crag item names reconstructed.

name: Treasure Hunt
offer: A supply courier is missing. Ask the sentinel at the Howth bridge.

steps.text: Speak to the named sentinel at the Howth bridge about the missing courier.
Return to Gaenor and tell him what you learned.
Visit the enchantress Cadalind at the tower north of Howth.
Kill a walking rock (a small one works too).
Return to the enchantress, then speak to Glom the fomorie.
Kill a deamhan creig.
Wearing the necklace of finding, search beneath the stones by the deamhan creigs for the gem.
Take the gem to Cadalind and choose a weapon.
Give the sparkly gem to Glom for a brooch.

name: Sheerie Mischief
offer: Talk to the gurite tempriar in Lough Gur.

steps.text: Find the gurite tempriar near Innis Carthaig (at night).
Return to Anice in Mag Mell.
Talk to Sentinel Giolladhe at the tower in Bri Leith; he buys the pearl and names Driss.
Kill mist sheeries at the pond west of the tower until Driss appears, and kill him.
Return the scrap of mist cloth to Anice.

name: A Piece of Gormghlaith's Mind
offer: I'm making tea and need a few ingredients.

steps.text: Get two river beetle drone carapaces on the shore just south of Ardagh.
Return them to Gormghlaith south of the Howth entrance.
Tell Sentinel Beacan, left of the Howth gate, about the spraggons.
Tell Chief Proinnsias in the central building about the [spraggons].
Clear spraggons at the spraggon den.
Kill the spraggonoll named Boss in the roofless barn.
Walk around inside the barn to collect four blackthorn leaves.
Return the corpse to the chief.
Give Gormghlaith the leaves and say [that's all there was].

name: Bria's Savior
offer: Take this letter to my sister Bria and help her with a troublesome curmudgeon.

steps.text: Take the letter to Bria on the farm north of the bridge near Ardee (follow the river).
Kill the wandering curmudgeon in the field and bring its head.
Give Bria the head.
Return to Kaenia with Bria's letter.
Take the letter to Ailidh southeast of Caille by the stone circle.
Kill the faerie drake Tric on the ridge north of the log west of Caille; do not hurt the empyreans.

notes: Some classes were not offered the quest (Hero, Eldritch, Enchanter, Druid) - possibly a shield-user restriction.

name: Essence of Hostility
offer: An evil warrior of the old war was slain, but his bracer remains, carried by a rolling stone.

steps.text: Retrieve the cursed bracer from the rolling stone on the east side of the lake.
Take it back to Andraste by the Tir na mBeo well and choose to [cleanse] it.
Find the Fallen One at night by the standing stone where ghastly siabra spawn, between the parthanan farm and the buildings south of it, and give him the bracer.
Kill the hill hounds.
The Fallen One attacks: kill him.

name: Occupation of Lough Gur (version 1)
offer: Discover why the gurites occupy Lough Gur when there is nothing there they should want.

steps.text: Talk to Chief Bran Llyr in Culraid.
See Kern, the enchanter in Innis Carthaig.
Get two swords from empyrean keepers in northeast Bri Leith.
Give the swords to Barra, the weapon merchant near the Innis Carthaig stable keeper.
Speak with Sarena, the poison vendor in Innis Carthaig.
Seek out the cluricaun Smidget on the north side of the island in Lough Gur.
Return the gem to Aziliz.
Fight the curmudgeon Curmie outside Innis Carthaig.
Return to Aziliz and say [tower of Tir na mBeo].

name: Occupation of Lough Gur (version 2)
offer: Investigate the gurite occupation. See Solas near Ceannai.

steps.text: Solas wants the head of a curmudgeon fighter before he will talk.
Give the head to Solas near Ceannai.
Get two druid daggers on the west side of Lough Gur.
Deliver the daggers to Trefor in the gurite raider camp.
Get the treasure from the named cluricaun Smirky.
Show Trefor the ring.
Give Aziliz the ring.

steps.whisper: would like to do more treasure hunting
steps.text: Tell Trefor you [would like to do more treasure hunting].
Iago gives you a sack of rotting fish to lure Curmie; give it to him.

steps.whisper: search for treasure of the lost tower of tir na mbeo
steps.text: Tell Aziliz the gurites [search for treasure of the lost tower of Tir na mBeo].

name: The Broken Seal
offer: The koalinth would be better locked away, and I have found the magical means - but I need your help.

steps.text: Go deep into the koalinth caves and fetch a carved piece of aventurine from the koalinth castellan.
Get the glowing fungus from the koalinth elder.
Return to Druid Tobryn by the tree southwest of Tir Urphost.

steps.where: mouth of the Koalinth Tribal Caverns
steps.text: Use the medallion at the mouth of the cave.
Return to Druid Tobryn.

notes: Ending after the guardian is cut off.

name: Sea Shell Sleeves
offer: I can have sea shell sleeves made for you if you gather the materials.

steps.text: Kill a bird-eating frog in Cruachan Gorge.
Give the hide to Greagoir in Mag Mell.
Get bark from an irewood sapling near the outpost between Connla and Innis Carthaig.
Give the unfinished sleeves and bark to Gavina in Connla.
Find Seary on the spit of island directly southwest of Connla.
Return to Gavina to finish the sleeves.
Take the note to Kennocha.

notes: Some needed Seeking Glory first.

name: Sraoi's Heart
offer: I need four things.

steps.text: Get an essence of strength from a walking rock in the Silvermine Mountains.
Return to Labhaoise.
Get a vial of cloudy liquid from a fog phantom in the Cliffs of Moher.
Return to Labhaoise.
Get a vial of clear liquid from a rock clipper.
Return to Labhaoise.
Find and kill Sraoi, a named streaming wisp north of the Basar bridge, at night.
Return to Labhaoise for your reward.

name: The Piper's Price
offer: Rats plague Innis Carthaig. Help me make rat traps.

steps.text: Get wood from an irewood sapling.
Get mandibles from a giant ant.
Return to Amynda with the parts.
Glennard's staff for the chieftess was stolen by the rats; search their den on the hillside southwest of town.
Return the staff to Glennard and choose a weapon.
Chieftess Niamh asks you to watch the rat-catcher do his job at dusk.
Take the bag of money to the rat-catcher near the rat lair.
Return to the chieftess.
Visit the vaultkeeper at the tower by the portal to Hy Brasil near Connla.
Return to the chieftess: the rat-catcher has taken the children.
Rescue the children from the cottage on the farm with the black horses.
Return to the chieftess and choose your chest armour.

notes: Pied-piper story with a dusk event; the rescue step is reconstructed (rat-catcher confrontation).

name: Larylle's Necklace
offer: Bring me a golden chain and three claws and I will make a necklace.

steps.text: Get a golden chain from the luch catchers in Lough Gur.
Give the chain to Larylle upstairs in the main building in Ardee.
Get a bronze claw from a water badger in the river by Connla.
Get a silver claw from a Silvermine badger across the lake from Ardagh.
Kill Scar-nose, who appears after the local rocks, spraggonolls and badgers are cleared.
Return to Larylle for her necklace.

name: Search for Nasco's Spear
offer: Travel to Howth; speak with Keriann and tell her I sent you.

steps.text: Speak with Keriann in the main hut in Howth and tell her Aziliz sent you.
Speak with Kyli on the pontoon in Connla.
Find and kill Nasco at night in the curves of the road to Ceannai.
Show Kyli the spear.
Bring the spear to Aziliz.

name: Sile's Sight
offer: I have a treasure project, but I am no judge of character. Run up to Sile; she will tell me if you are worthy.

steps.text: Talk to Sile, who is blind, in the depression beside the water due east of the round wooden building in Ardagh.
Tell Oran that Sile says you have a [pure heart].
Give the note to Ardghal Corcoran, dancing on the table in the Tir na mBeo inn.
Take the package to Empyrean Keeper Rasa in the empyrean village northeast of Caille.

steps.whisper: May I have a perfect glass orb?
steps.text: Without violence, ask an empyrean wisp for a perfect glass orb.
Give Keeper Rasa the orb.
Ask a moss sheerie for a bag of moss.
Ask Primrose for [poppies].
Return to Keeper Rasa.
Take the salve to Ardghal.
Give Sile the salve and tell her about her [sight].
Tell Oran that Sile's blindness has been cured.

notes: A peaceful quest: killing the wisp, sheerie or primrose should not advance it. Oran turns out to be Empyrean Keeper Oran (final reward cut off).

name: Season of Remorse
offer: Speak to the empyrean guardian at the standing stones north of Druim Cain.

steps.text: Speak to the empyrean guardian in the centre of the standing stone ring north of Druim Cain.
Kill two morsmutare witches in Mount Collory; the last whispers a name as she dies.
Kill two vanishers east of the mile gate mountain range for the essence jar.
Return to the empyrean guardian.
Kill Witch Xia and her summoned pet in Breifine.
Return to the empyrean guardian for the reward.

notes: Mount Collory and Breifine are classic frontier zones (region 200).

name: Storyteller's Tale
offer: A siabra family that befriended the Celts was murdered by their own kind. Their ghosts walk at night.

steps.text: Go down the beach south, up into the hills, to the camp where the ghosts walk at night, and talk to Chief Gaeth.
Talk to Marus inside the stone building in Connla.
Swim across to Kaylee by the tower with her husband and get the potion of respite.
Give the potion to Chief Gaeth to release his family.

name: Poison for Ivy
offer: I am hurt. Help me get a remedy from Ivy Magennis.

steps.text: Kill a botonid tuber northwest of the fomorian house west of Droighaid for its root.
Go to Ivy Magennis in Droighaid and tell her [Ruairi is hurt].
Give her the root.
Kill a pollen spore in the same area.
Kill a fomorian for its blood near the mouth of Fomor.
Give Ivy the powder and the blood.
Return to Ruairi and give him the box; choose an ivy weapon.

name: Returning for More
offer: I can make you a new and improved cloak, but I need various items.

steps.text: Get spider's silk from an arachnid in Treibh Caillte.
Return the silk to Banba; she now wants [Elven Gossamer].
Talk to Tressa Gorrym'jiarg and complete Traces of the Mad Changlings for the elven gossamer.
Take the gossamer to Banba; her sewing basket is missing.
Talk to Guard Dooley under the spiral staircase of the tower to the Cliffs of Moher.
Find the ghostly Aengus Osrithe in the stone circle near Tir Urphost at night; tell him Banba is a [firbolg].
Return the basket to Banba; she wants cloth dye from Reeni.
Help Reeni in Ardagh (Returning to the Source) for the cloth dye.
Give Banba the dye.

notes: Final cloak name not recorded (item pass 2). Contains two sub-quests.

name: Returning to the Source
offer: Take this sealed scroll to Sarena in Innis Carthaig.

steps.text: Take the sealed scroll to Sarena, the poison merchant in Innis Carthaig.
Give the scroll to Reeni.
Take the scroll to Jarlath beside the healer Waljan through the north gate of Tir na Nog.
Give the scroll to Tethra in Ardee.
Head back to Reeni for the cloth dye.

name: The Anxious Healer
offer: A grey man haunts the area. I need components to deal with him.

steps.text: Speak with Merucha.
Kill the named irewolf Lashold in the faerie horse meadow by the guard tower southwest of Caille.
Get an irewood branch in Mount Collory outside Druim Cain.
Return to Cinead at the top of the guard tower near Tir Urphost.
Confront the Grey Man.

notes: Walkthrough is fragmentary (Grey Man and Merucha steps reconstructed).

name: Traces of the Mad Changlings
offer: You want elven gossamer? Bring me the head of the mad changeling leader.

steps.text: From Caille head southeast across Moon Lake to the tall standing stones; the mad changelings are at the foot of the hills behind them. Kill Lusmorebane.
steps.loc_note: mad changeling camp at the foot of the hills behind Watcher Rylie's stone, Moon Lake (Warcry spoiler 533; level 32 per Uthgard bestiary)

steps.text: Bring the head back to Tressa.

name: Missing Tapestry
offer: My tapestry is in the fomorian settlement west of Droighaid. Take this bag.

steps.text: Wipe out the fomorian settlement west of Droighaid.
Search the house for the tapestry.
Return the tapestry bag to Lilerbad in Droighaid.

notes: Fomorian monster names in the settlement to resolve. Hero/Champion/Eldritch mapping inferred.

name: Crace's Desire
offer: Go to Fidelma in Bann-didein and ask her for the sample.

steps.text: Go to Fidelma in Bann-didein and ask for the sample.
Return the sample to Crace.
Hunt the mantid surveyors by the mantid mud huts north of Domnann.
Return the carapace to Fidelma.
Take the finished breastplate to Crace.

notes: Alternate mantid-side branch: say [Crace] to the surveyor, kill an ixthiar ruinator for the Ixthiar armour instead.

name: Criofan's Fish
offer: My pet golden fish swallowed my pearl ring and swam up the river; I think the siabran kedger Kaen caught it.

steps.text: Find Kaen Kedger behind the building up the east hillside of the kedger camp (daytime).
Fetch the stomach lining of a faerie beetle in Lough Gur.
Return the items to Criofan on the bridge north of Connla.

name: Freeing Osier
offer: My beloved, lost many years ago, is now a spectral wickerman. Help me free him.

steps.text: Get a wolfhound bladder from a large red wolfhound.
Find Uisetan in Connla.
Give the bladder to Kiana in Ardee.
Kill a dew sheerie; the bladder fills with its water.
Seek out Osier at night at the four standing stones south of Connla over the river and give him the bladder (do not fight him).
Return to Odharnait in Ardagh with the satchel.

notes: Added in patch 1.37 as a level 19 quest (Allakhazam now lists 35-40). Odharnait takes two objects from the satchel (reward cut off, item pass 2). Osier must be a quest NPC that accepts the bladder while normally a monster.

name: Viraniel's Plague
offer: I am sick. Get me the potion from Dwerrania in the druid grove.

steps.text: Ask Dwerrania in the druid grove for the [potion for Viraniel].
Give Viraniel the potion; she turns into a skeleton warrior and flies off.
Return to Dwerrania.
Find the alchemist Eraliwyr hidden deep in the Spraggon Den (talk to him; he attacks) and kill him.
Kill a sand worm on the Bog of Cullen beach for its tongue.
Kill a greater zephyr east of Tir Urphost up the hill.
Kill a luch catcher south-southwest of Treibh Caillte.
Return the items to Dwerrania.
Check on Viraniel.

notes: Eraliwyr gives 5-10 gold on death. Variant step: luch hunter's bladder.

name: Magic's Scar
offer: Make a delivery to Ariana in Caille.

steps.text: Talk to Ariana, the mentalist staff merchant in Caille.
See Meagane in Druim Cain and prove Ariana sent you by saying her last name, Silvereyes.
Kill what Meagane asks (a rage wolf) and bring her the wolf ear necklace.
Return the necklace to Meagane.
Deliver the fiery red ruby to Ariana.
Kill Eugor, a rare named evanescer in Mount Collory at night.
Return to Meagane with the second ruby.

notes: Formerly the Eugor one-time drop.

name: Xaxnxi's Quest
offer: Bring me what I ask from the creatures around here.

steps.text: Kill arboreal remnants west of Xaxnxi for five bags of eitn ot pyrk.
Return the bags to Xaxnxi.
Retrieve a complete carcass from a waterstrider hatchling far west along the shoreline.
Return the carcass.
Kill a fearann wyvern hatchling northeast of Xaxnxi for its stomach.
Bring the stomach to Xaxnxi.

notes: Other classes not listed (item pass 2).

name: Black Plague (Hib)
offer: A plague affects people in Tir na Nog. Go to Eavann.

steps.text: Go to Eavann, downstairs in the building opposite the Nightshade/Ranger guild.
Speak to Tiarnan upstairs; he gives you a letter for his sister.
Take Tiarnan's letter to Keriann in the Chief's hut in Howth and keep talking to her.
Return Keriann's note to Tiarnan.
Talk with Eavann about news from the druids.
Return to Waljan; you are sick too.
Travel to the Coruscating Mines and slay a glow worm just inside the entrance.
Take the worm fungus back to Waljan for a cure.
Journey to Darkness Falls and slay Archivist Borath.
Return to Waljan with the stoppered wondrous potion.

name: Catch of the Day
offer: Go to the Cliffs of Moher and talk to the tidal sheerie Aessa.

steps.text: Talk to the named tidal sheerie Aessa.
Go to two cliff dweller camps; their spearmen or hunters recognise your necklace and attack. Survive and kill them.
Return to Aessa.
Kill the fanged sinach on the beach south of Aessa.
Deal with the koalinth on the beach south-southeast.
Find the elder tidal sheerie in Connacht.
Your reward is on the tooth of a sharptoothed megafelid southwest of Dun Ailinne.

notes: Version 1 asks for an elder tidal sheerie and Touched (Connacht 58k,6.2k). The megafelid is in the Hibernian frontier (zone guess Connacht per loc).

name: Search For The Missing Smith
offer: The smith Ceard is missing.

steps.text: Talk to Sian in Mag Mell; tell him Ceard is missing.
Find the confused smith Ceard wandering the beach past the fogs in the Cliffs of Moher.
Ceard was robbed by a cliff dweller hunter; get his ring back.
Take the ring back to Ceard (it breaks Scaird's hold but the curse kills him).
Take the ring to Cleary the enchanter in Tir Urphost to remove the curse.

notes: Ceard roams a long route across the Cliffs of Moher.

name: The West Wind
offer: Speak with Tiarnan; someone has gone missing on the west wind.

steps.text: See Tiarnan upstairs near the rogue trainers.
Give the note to Guard Dooley at the guard tower west of the Tir na Nog north gate.
Find the crazy lurikeen Doran.
Kill Aoife, the greater zephyr on the hill southeast of Doran (clear the zephyrs to make her appear).
Return to Doran: the person you seek has gone home.
Bairfhionn tells you his home is Howth.
Ask in Howth: he is near the stepping stones.
Talk to him by the stepping stones.
Return to Bairfhionn.

notes: The missing man's name is not recorded (needs research or a spawn by the Howth stepping stones).

name: Twisted Evil
offer: Speak with Jyrlan in Necht.

steps.text: Southwest of Necht, kill two cutthroat vines and cut their roots with the knife.
Kill Luaire and his three named friends.
Drop the green elixir at the base of Luaire's tree.
Drop the red elixir at the rock at 10k,21k.
Go east and drop the yellow elixir at 24.7k,21k.
Southwest from there, drop the brown elixir at 17.8k,28k.
Return to Jyrlan.

notes: Elixir vials are handed out at the start (assumed). Outsiders faction matters.

name: Banba's Road to Grandmaster
offer: Take this letter to Armin, the Tailor Master in Tir na Nog.

steps.text: Take Banba's letter to Master Armin.
Take the cloak pattern back to Banba.
Get a vial of blood from a tunnel imp in the mines.
Get rigid gemclicker plates.
Return the items to Banba.
Get a vial of brilliant prismatic pigment from Reeni in Ardagh.
Take the pigment back to Banba.
Give the cloak to Armin for inspection.
Take the note to Banba.

notes: One cloak per class (Bard, Warden, Champion, Nightshade, Ranger, Hero, Enchanter, Druid, Mentalist, Animist, Blademaster, Valewalker, Eldritch). Gold amounts lowered in an 8/13/03 fix.

name: Face the Twisted
offer: Hunt the twisted creatures and bring me proof.

steps.text: Find the twisted creatures in the sylvan valley and kill a treecutter.
Kill a barkstripper.
Return the two heads to Vikta in Necht.
Stilter body.
Vine piece.
Sanidon tail.
Ravaging marine shriller voicebox.
Marine shriller voicebox.
Beach shrouder wing.
Beach anglator bone (they come out of the water when sanidons are attacked).
Treant piece.
Talk to Vikta; he gives you a bag. Use it.
Give the bag to Vikta.

notes: Reward: AF 88-90 (cloth 44) legs/gloves by class (names from item pass 2).

name: The Touch of Amadan Duhb
offer: Find my son Davian and help him if he needs it.

steps.text: Go to Basar and see Erech the merchant.
Climb the tower and talk to the guard.
Talk to the stablemaster in front of Druim Ligen.
Find Bria in the back of the barn at the parthanan farm north of Tir na Nog, with her son Davian, who can't move.
Get information about a cure from Llyn the healer in Ardee.
Take the information back to Bria.
Kill a koalinth slinker in the Cliffs of Moher for seaweed.
Return the seaweed to Bria.
Get a vial of blood from an Amadan Touched.
Return the vial to Bria.
Kill Amadan Dubh.
Take the vial of his blood back to Bria.

notes: Amadan Dubh was moved south of his old spot later; zone/loc to resolve. This Bria is a different NPC from Bria in Bria's Savior (check).

name: Immortal Gift
offer: Ask Ascatinius what is bothering me.

steps.text: Ask Ascatinius in Connla what is [bothering] Kinney.
In Treibh Caillte, kill the befuddled rock golem on the golem teleporters to reach Hervelina.
Kill Driff Tinel.
Take the blood to Hervelina.
Kill Ceracor.
Return to Hervelina.
Kill Pericolias the Dreaded.
Give the fang to Hervelina.
Find the alchemy book in Hursk the Alchemist's room.
Read the book.
Kill the dreaded ursine to reach the forge.
Use the forge to obtain the Faqist.
Give the Faqist to Ascatinius in Connla.

notes: Ascatinius appears in Kinney's building twice a day.

name: Fylara's Armor
offer: Bring me what I need for the armour.

steps.text: Kill a gorge shriller north across the wooden bridge near Aalid Feie for its tongue.
Clear an entire ixthiar nest before it respawns to make the broodmother appear, and kill her.
Return the parts to Fylara.

notes: Broodmother spawn wait was reduced in 1.62.

name: The Lost Relics
offer: Speak with the old man in Tir na mBeo about Dagda's Harp.

steps.text: Talk to the old man in the hut at the back of Tir na mBeo about Dagda's Harp.
Kill geas bound protectors by the rocks past the Siopa fruit stand in the Bog of Cullen.
Return to Lobais in the throne room.
Ask the master mentalist in the Chamber of Magic about the Stone of Lia Fail.
Kill a gem-dusted skeleton in the mines.
Kill a gemclicker.
Return to the master mentalist; after his vision he sends you to Ceannai.
At the four stone slabs northeast of the Ceannai fruit stand, use Dagda's Harp.
Kill the demon Abbadona.
Return to Lobais, tell him you were misled, and give him the harp.

Animist: Defender's Cloak of the Clear Mind
Enchanter: Defender's Cloak of the Clear Mind
Mentalist: Defender's Cloak of the Clear Mind
Eldritch: Defender's Cloak of the Clear Mind
Blademaster: Defender's Cloak of the Strong Arm
Hero: Defender's Cloak of the Strong Arm
Champion: Defender's Cloak of the Strong Arm
Valewalker: Defender's Cloak of the Strong Arm

notes: Alternate mine targets: unseelie underviewer, Underviewer Treeal, coerced grover. Harp source step reconstructed (protectors drop it).

name: Corruptors, Botonids, and Trade
offer: Help us gain an alliance with the mantids of Krrzck.

steps.text: Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms.
And two heads.
Turn in the parts to Krazckz in Krrzck, west-northwest of Necht (raise mantid faction by killing treecutters and barkstrippers if needed).
Kill three corruptors just over the rock bridge for their skin.
Kill two botonid rencanraiders south of the octonid forest for their teeth.
Return the parts to Krazckz.

choice: Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Nurturing Health
Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Everlasting Fortitude
Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Silent Resistance
Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Stunning Regrowth
Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Lost Knowledge

notes: Reward choice offered since 1.61.

name: The Sylvan's Pain
offer: Tell me your name; a sylvan suffers.

steps.text: Talk to Iesia in Droighaid; tell her [Sandu sent] you.
Talk to Eersie in Necht; tell her [Iesia sent] you.
Kill what Eersie names (a soaring manta for its tail).
Give the part to Evyene on the beach behind Necht and tell her you [seek a cure].
Get a tentacle from a death shroud in World's End.
Get blood from a chalico near the death shrouds.
Seek out Xcrzrk outside Krrzck and tell her [Evyene sent] you (or kill her for the egg).
Give Evyene the tentacle, blood and egg.
Give Iesia the potion when she asks.
Drink some of the potion.
Give the potion to Cailbyn east outside Droighaid.
Give the note to Sandu and choose two rings.

notes: Live in patch 1.60. Two of eleven no-trade rings (list partly cut off).

name: The Tree Maidens
offer: Take this ticket to Necht and kill a stilter.

steps.text: Kill a stilter northwest of the sanidon pond west of Necht.
Give Anyro in Necht the tentacle and say [Tree Maidens].
Kill a corruptor near the stepping stones on the road to Krrzck.
Kill a tittering tree dervish in Cothrom Gorge.
Talk to Tieru in Aalid Feie; tell him you are [missing one].
Kill the guard in the gap in the zone wall east of Aalid Feie (he calls two friends).
Say [hello] at the tree and answer the maiden: [the maidens of the trees], [to free their voice], then sing [morwynol gan yr llais].
Speak to Raiaya and choose a gem.

notes: Bainshee/Vampiir/Mauler songs are post-1.65. Tree-maiden NPC names (Adwyth, Anhylaw) to resolve.

name: Piaras and Lhia
offer: I have a couple of things I need you to do.

steps.text: Kill a cliff dweller spearman in the Cliffs of Moher and return.
Kill a bog crawler in the Bog of Cullen and return.
Kill a tidal sheerie for a clump of seaweed and return.
Kill the breaker roane companion in the water.
Kill Lhia in Lough Gur (night spawn).
Return to Piaras in Howth.

notes: Level 50 -> 49 in patch 1.65. Return to Piaras between each task (merged into the final turn-in here).

name: Rhoiwyn's Necklace
offer: Bring me what Garyn needs to free Rhoiwyn's necklace.

steps.text: Get a rock from a granidon in Cothrom Gorge, toward the waterfall.
Get a leg bone from a mad grazer in the Vale of Balor.
Give the items to Garyn in the Grove of Aalid Feie.
Venture into the depths of Tur Suil and seek out Abomos the Soultrapper.
Return to Carylina on the west rampart of Droighaid.

name: Writhing Death
offer: The Outland residents are attacked by a writhing, swarming mass.

steps.text: Speak to Fedail (or Hedierna) in the outlander town of Altan Garran in Cothrom Gorge.
Kill Cronwort northwest of town.
Kill Fuilwort.
Kill Tachtwort.
Return their remains to Fedail.
Kill Marfoirwort, the source of the worts.
Bring the root to Treal.

notes: 1.64 opened it to level 49 and added rewards.

name: Strange Bedfellows (Hib)
offer: Speak with Mystemas again at the imp merchants in Darkness Falls.

steps.text: Speak with Mystemas at the imp merchants in Darkness Falls.
Kill a glimmer griever in Sheeroe Hills for a glimmer stone.
Return to Mystemas with the glimmer stone.
Kill Ambassador Mannam.
Kill the Princess; Caisha rises from the well in the princess room.
Kill Caisha to capture her spirit in the soul stone.
Deliver Caisha's soul stone to Mystemas.
Report back to Waljan with the diplomatic documents.

notes: Part of the 1.65 Black Plague chain (all three realms). Darkness Falls bosses are raid bosses: quest kills count for a player in the killing raid/group.

name: Breaking the Blade (Hib)
offer: Assist me in the fight against the Army of Shadows.

steps.text: Travel to Darkness Falls and speak with Mystemas.
Kill Director Kobil.
Return to Mystemas.
Kill Prince Abdin.
Return to Mystemas for your reward.

name: Sloithi One Time Drop
notes: In a hut in the siog camp.

name: Wilde's One Time Drop
notes: Named faerie horse southeast of the two giant mushrooms.

name: Brannigan One Time Drop
notes: Rare named cluricaun at the mushroom ring across the water from Howth.

name: Muir One Time Drop
notes: Named merman south along the water past the stepping-stone bridge south of Howth, where the water forks. A Pooka Hide Vest is also listed.

name: Banghaisgidheach One Time Drop
notes: Named luch hunter near the Treibh Caillte entrance (also 18k,22k around 19:00).

name: Danderpaw One Time Drop
notes: Named ire wolf with two guards on the hill east of the Ceannai merchant shack. A Warden did not get the drop (armour-type restricted).

name: Withe One Time Drop
notes: Named phantom wickerman near Druim Ligen by the river (night). Reward name not recorded.

name: Famine One Time Drop
notes: Named alp luachra past Basar toward Druim Ligen. The wail ring is for Bainshee (post-1.65).

name: Luchtigern One Time Drop
notes: Named greater luch east and north of Treibh Caillte (~9:00 game time).

name: Thistle One Time Drop
notes: Rare spawn in the trees beside the gorge rats north of Druim Ligen.

name: Anord One Time Drop
notes: Named evanescer (only New Frontiers locs recorded).

name: Neese One Time Drop
notes: Named siabra mireguard at the encampment around two glowing rocks by the pond nearest the siabra lookout tower.

name: Spifnar One Time Drop
notes: Named Cruachan imp above the curmudgeon smoker camp and lake.

name: Dorbal One Time Drop
notes: Named amadan touched northeast of Basar east of the road to Druim Ligen. Pierce users only (a Mentalist could not get it).

name: Little Star One Time Drop
notes: Named roan stepper up the hill from the curmudgeon valley in the northwest corner.

name: Muroi One Time Drop
notes: Named siabra on top of a rock in the raider camp near the mermen.

name: Ailbe's Claw -- One Time Drop
notes: Named deamhan hound. Drops for pierce users only.

name: Nasher One Time Drop (Hib)
notes: Same monster as A245/M245 (enemy frontier).

name: Amadan One Time Drop
notes: Rare named amadan touched in the valley beside the road to Druim Ligen with the pookas and alp luachra.

name: Niy the Overseer One Time Drop
notes: South of the well plateau northeast of Caille, near the Cursed Forest entrance; may need empyrean overseers killed. Large weapon users only.

name: Brarn One Time Drop
notes: Spawns at the tent flap of the cliff dweller beach camp at the south end of the Cliffs.

name: Guardian Hru One Time Drop
notes: Named empyrean guardian east of Caille between two groups of empyreans.

name: Oak Man One Time Drop
notes: Rare spawn among the grovewoods in the grove in front of Druim Cain.

name: Dob One Time Drop
notes: Extremely rare named bear in the bog; pierce trainers (30 pierce to equip).

name: Shadowgnash One Time Drop
notes: Named pooka by the black wraiths on the Bri Leith side of the river.

name: Badb One Time Drop
notes: In the Bog of Cullen tower at night.

name: Twisted Barkstripper Treant Wood -- Kill Task
notes: Paud is a named treant at 34k,25k.

name: Rage Wolf Teeth -- Kill Task
notes: Reward a gem worth 2 gold per tooth.

name: Gold Lined Drinking Horn -- Kill Task
Vigilant One Leaves -- Kill Task
notes: Mel is a named tree dervish at 21.5k,13.5k; vigilant one kills cost faction.

name: Cutthroat Vine Poison Sac -- Kill Task
Vial of Glowing Gasses -- Kill Task
Detrital Crab Meat -- Kill Task
notes: Maire at 9331,27200 in Connla.

name: Vial of Glowing Gases (Eiral) -- Kill Task
Cervideth Antlers -- Kill Task
notes: Giver not recorded. Giver: the walkthrough says only 'a Vale of Balor merchant'; Miniine is the server's merchant there.

name: Umber Bear Teeth -- Kill Task
notes: Umber bears in Dun na nGed area.

name: Melancholic Fairy Wing -- Kill Task
notes: Broc in Siopa (9k,38k).

name: Spiteful Sylvanshade Head -- Kill Task
notes: Jack on the second floor of a tree at 31766,52539.

name: Venomous Spore Poison Sac -- Kill Task
